welcomeText: Over 6 years shipping production mobile apps for fintech, social and logistics platforms. I care about clean architecture, smooth UI and getting things through App Store review without losing my mind.
skillsDescription: Six years deep in React Native and TypeScript, building and shipping production apps across fintech, social networking, logistics and live streaming. Comfortable owning a feature from architecture to App Store release.
aboutText: I started messing with technology in 2018 and got hooked on JavaScript front end. Since then I moved into React Native full-time, and now work as a senior mobile engineer building secure, production-grade apps used by thousands of people.
